transcript:
Where should I submit my reimbursement forms?
(A) To Ms. Chen in accounting.
(B) About two hundred dollars.
(C) Yes, I formed a new team.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Where' (nộp ở đâu) → trả lời nơi/người nhận 'To Ms. Chen in accounting' (A). (B) nói số tiền, (C) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh- và lặp âm 'form'.

transcript:
When is the new payroll system going live?
(A) It's been pushed back to April.
(B) In the payroll office.
(C) A live demonstration.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'When' → đáp gián tiếp: hệ thống bị lùi sang tháng Tư 'pushed back to April' (A). (B) trả lời nơi chốn, (C) lặp từ 'live'.

transcript:
Who's interviewing the candidates for the analyst position?
(A) The position was posted online.
(B) Mr. Patel and two managers from finance.
(C) Yes, at ten o'clock.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Who' (ai phỏng vấn) → 'Mr. Patel and two managers from finance' (B). (A) lặp từ 'position', (C) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh-.

transcript:
Why is the printer on the third floor out of service?
(A) Three copies, please.
(B) Its paper tray is broken.
(C) On the second floor.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Why' (vì sao máy in hỏng) → nêu lý do 'Its paper tray is broken' (B). (A) gần âm 'three/third', (C) trả lời nơi chốn.

transcript:
How long will the software update take?
(A) About twenty minutes.
(B) I'd rather take the train.
(C) Yes, it's up to date.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'How long' (bao lâu) → khoảng thời gian 'About twenty minutes' (A). (B) lặp từ 'take', (C) trả lời Yes và lặp âm 'update/up to date'.

transcript:
Which spreadsheet has the updated budget figures?
(A) Sure, I'll update it.
(B) The one Kevin sent this morning.
(C) The budget meeting is on Friday.

questions.explanation: Hỏi 'Which' (bảng tính nào) → 'The one Kevin sent this morning' (B). (A) lặp 'update' và không trả lời câu hỏi, (C) lặp 'budget' nhưng nói về cuộc họp.

transcript:
Have you finished reviewing the job applications?
(A) An application form.
(B) She finished first.
(C) I still have about ten left.

questions.explanation: Câu Yes/No hỏi đã xem xong hồ sơ chưa → đáp gián tiếp 'chưa, còn khoảng mười bộ' (C). (A) lặp 'application', (B) lặp 'finished' nhưng sai chủ ngữ.

transcript:
Isn't the IT department moving to the new building?
(A) Only the help desk staff.
(B) The building manager.
(C) Move it to the left.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định → đáp gián tiếp: chỉ nhân viên help desk chuyển đi (A). (B) lặp 'building', (C) lặp 'move'.

transcript:
Do you know if the quarterly report has been approved?
(A) Every three months.
(B) The director is still reviewing it.
(C) I approve of the new design.

questions.explanation: Hỏi báo cáo quý đã được duyệt chưa → 'giám đốc vẫn đang xem' tức là chưa (B). (A) liên tưởng 'quarterly', (C) lặp 'approve'.

transcript:
You've met our new accounting manager, haven't you?
(A) Our account number is on the invoice.
(B) No, but I'm having lunch with her tomorrow.
(C) Yes, the meeting was moved.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi hỏi đã gặp quản lý kế toán mới chưa → 'chưa, nhưng mai tôi ăn trưa với cô ấy' (B). (A) gần âm 'accounting/account', (C) gần âm 'met/meeting'.

transcript:
Should we hold the training session online or in the conference room?
(A) Yes, the session was useful.
(B) It holds about forty people.
(C) Several employees are working from home that week.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (trực tuyến hay phòng họp) → đáp gián tiếp: nhiều người làm ở nhà tuần đó, nên tổ chức trực tuyến (C). (A) trả lời Yes cho câu lựa chọn, (B) lặp 'hold'.

transcript:
Would you like the report printed or sent by e-mail?
(A) An electronic copy is fine.
(B) I reported it yesterday.
(C) Yes, I'd like that.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (in hay gửi e-mail) → 'bản điện tử là được' = gửi e-mail (A). (B) gần âm 'report', (C) trả lời Yes cho câu lựa chọn.

transcript:
Could you help me set up the projector before the presentation?
(A) It was a good presentation.
(B) Sure, I'll be there in five minutes.
(C) He's setting the table.

questions.explanation: Lời nhờ giúp lắp máy chiếu → đồng ý 'Sure, I'll be there in five minutes' (B). (A) lặp 'presentation' nhưng sai thì, (C) gần âm 'set up/setting'.

transcript:
Why don't we ask Ms. Garcia to lead the budget review?
(A) Because the budget was approved.
(B) The review was positive.
(C) She's on vacation until next week.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't we…' là lời đề nghị, không hỏi lý do → đáp gián tiếp: cô ấy nghỉ phép đến tuần sau (C). (A) bẫy trả lời 'Because', (B) lặp 'review'.

transcript:
The new laptops for the sales team arrived this morning.
(A) Great, I'll start setting them up.
(B) The sales figures are higher.
(C) No, I'll arrive tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Câu trần thuật báo laptop mới đã đến → phản hồi hợp lý 'tôi sẽ bắt đầu cài đặt' (A). (B) lặp 'sales', (C) lặp 'arrive'.
